digest.en: Europe & Russia leads the board this hour with Russian Students See University Dreams Deferred As More Spots Go To Veterans. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर यूरोप और रूस की अगुवाई है, आज जम्मू-श्रीनगर हाईवे पर यातायात बंद, अमरनाथ यात्रियों का जत्था जा सकेगा; बारिश का भी अलर्ट मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही एशिया-प्रशांत से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Russian Students See University Dreams Deferred As More Spots Go To Veterans
articles.summary: Young Russians hoping to attend university are finding they have poor odds of getting in this year, even with outstanding exam scores. One reason is a government quota system that favors veterans of the war in Ukraine and their children for coveted state-funded university spots. Russian Students See University Dreams Deferred As More Spots Go To Veterans.

articles.title: Iran Has Tested the Gulf. Now Washington Must Rethink Its Security Role, Says Former Trump NSC
articles.summary: Former Trump White House official Allison Minor says Iran's latest attacks exposed the limits of the traditional US security guarantee in the Gulf. She argues Washington should shift toward a regional security model built on shared capabilities, integration, and stronger partnerships. Iran Has Tested the Gulf. Now Washington Must Rethink Its Security Role, Says Former Trump NSC.

articles.title: Activists Call Baku Court's Sentencing Of Independent Journalists An 'Unmistakable Warning'
articles.summary: When Human Rights Watch's Georgi Gogia heard that several independent journalists were handed lengthy sentences this week by a court in the Azerbaijani capital, Baku, he didn't know what motivated the judge. But he does know the message is an "unmistakable warning." Activists Call Baku Court's Sentencing Of Independent Journalists An 'Unmistakable Warning'.

articles.title: Russia Launches Massive Missile And Drone Attack On Ukraine
articles.summary: Russia launched dozens of ballistic and cruise missiles, along with hundreds of drones, at Ukraine in the early hours of July 30 in another large-scale attack. Damage was reported in several cities, including Kyiv and Lviv. Russia Launches Massive Missile And Drone Attack On Ukraine.

articles.title: US Military Says Latest Strikes Target Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps
articles.summary: The US military said it launched dozens of strikes against targets linked to Iran's powerful Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) in response to Iranian attacks on American troops in Jordan after President Donald Trump had vowed to retaliate and "hit them very hard." articles.title: Kyiv’s clear message to New Delhi: Not a single Ukrainian drone sent to Pakistan
articles.summary: This assertion becomes particularly important, especially in light of reports during Operation Sindoor alleging that Pakistani forces were being supplied with drones originating from Ukraine. This claim has circulated but remained difficult to independently verify Kyiv’s clear message to New Delhi: Not a single Ukrainian drone sent to Pakistan.

articles.title: Putin's Shifting Rhetoric Now Echoes Criticism He Once Aimed At Kyiv
articles.summary: In 2018, Russian President Vladimir Putin accused Ukraine of using the war in its eastern Donbas region to cover up its alleged economic and social problems. In 2026, Putin has been blaming "external enemies" for Russia's issues, including its growing fuel crisis caused by Ukrainian drone attacks. Putin's Shifting Rhetoric Now Echoes Criticism He Once Aimed At Kyiv.

For the same reason it’s trying to drive Russian car owners crazy by forcing them to wait in crazy long lines at fueling stations. articles.title: Does Iran's Attack On Jordan Mark A Shift In Military Strategy?
articles.summary: In what appeared to be the first time Tehran initiated an attack against US targets since the war in the Persian Gulf began in late February, Iran fired ballistic missiles at American bases in Jordan late on July 28. Does Iran's Attack On Jordan Mark A Shift In Military Strategy?

articles.title: Hunger hampers Ebola response as cases top 3,200 in DR Congo
articles.summary: The UN emergency food agency appealed for immediate funding on Wednesday, warning that deepening hunger is undermining the response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) that has now infected more than 3,200 people. Hunger hampers Ebola response as cases top 3,200 in DR Congo.

articles.title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Targets Deep Inside Russia, Wildberries Hit Again
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck targets in several places inside Russia on July 29, including an oil refinery and a logistics center belonging to Russia's largest online retailer, Wildberries, as Kyiv expands its long-range strike campaign to pressure Moscow into peace negotiations. Ukrainian Drones Strike Targets Deep Inside Russia, Wildberries Hit Again.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits Another Wildberries Warehouse In Russia
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck a Wildberries warehouse in the Ryazan region, Russia, setting the building on fire. Wildberries confirmed the evacuation of the facility, marking another hit in a string of drone attacks on Russian industrial sites. Ukrainian drones struck industrial facilities in Russia's Ryazan region, with videos on social media showing a Wildberries warehouse engulfed in flames. Russia's largest online retailer said it evacuated the facility.

articles.summary: चीन ने जे-20 स्टेल्थ फाइटर जेट को वास्तविक नियंत्रण रेखा के करीब दो एयरबेस पर तैनात किया है. ओपन सोर्स इंटेलिजेंस के माध्यम से सैटेलाइट तस्वीरें सामने आई हैं जिनमें जे-20 जेट दिखाई दे रहे हैं. यह तैनाती आठ साल बाद हुई है जब जे-20 के इंजन और एवियोनिक्स को पूरी तरह से अपग्रेड किया गया था. करीब आठ साल बाद अपने इंजन और एवियोनिक्स को पूरी तरह अपग्रेड करने के बाद चीन का जे-20 स्टेल्थ फाइटर जेट एक बार फिर मैदान में कूद गया है.

articles.summary: वॉशिंगटन में जेलेंस्की और ट्रंप की मीटिंग को 48 घंटे भी नहीं हुए थे कि रूस ने यूक्रेन पर काल बरसा दिया. पुतिन की सेना ने 70 से ज्यादा बैलिस्टिक मिसाइलें और 280 ड्रोन्स दागकर दुनिया को सन्न कर दिया. हद तो तब हो गई जब एक रूसी Kh-101 मिसाइल सीधे NATO देश पोलैंड की सीमा में जा गिरी. इससे साफ है कि पुतिन ने ट्रंप की 'पीस डील' और भारत-चीन पर 100% पेनल्टी टैरिफ की धमकियों को कचरे के डिब्बे में फेंक दिया।
